description: The boss fight (boss-fight-mac) without the storm, to measure the fight without rain and its effects. Identical to boss-fight-mac except the batch file: at frame 1900 the console runs `bat bossclear` (same length as `bat benchboss`, so every key lands on the same frame; typed through console_later, which gives the same keys and frames as boss-fight-mac's hand-written ones, with the command readable in one place), and bossclear.txt forces SkyrimClear (fw 0000081A) where benchboss.txt forces the storm (fw 000C8220); god mode and the same spawns (two high-level dragons, 14 bandits, 2 storm atronachs) follow in the same order. The weather batch at frame 1510 (benchwx: SkyrimClear) is unchanged, so the sky is clear for the whole run. LB_VPAD=0 is set by the scenario's env, as in boss-fight-mac. Phases and shots as in boss-fight-mac.
